summary: Product COM QA proves a new PowerPoint PID and HWND before document operations, then checks slide-scoped native or raster QID owners and geometry digest.
invariants: No presentation is opened or saved until the COM HWND resolves to a PID absent from the preexisting PowerPoint census.
Native and raster QID ownership is exact per slide after reopen.
Chromium geometry is bound through OOXML readback and checked against reopened COM geometry.
forbidden: Do not attach to, save, close, or quit an ownership-uncertain PowerPoint process.
Do not treat reopen stability or geometry digest binding as cross-renderer visual parity.
